request.description: Changes label, help, options, validation, UI hints or status. `key`, `attributeKey` and `type` never change. Staff only. Reading needs question read access (ops lead, compliance, support); changes need question manage access (ops lead, super admin). Changes are audited and published as `question.changed`. Published question sets keep the snapshot they were approved with, so editing a question only affects sets submitted afterwards.
